radio_internal.text: The onboard radio connections are NSS8, SCK9, MOSI10, MISO11, RESET12, BUSY13 and DIO1=14. The V4.3 FEM setup uses GPIO7 HIGH, GPIO2 HIGH and GPIO5 HIGH, with DIO2 controlling the RF switch and receive in bypass mode. DIO3 supplies the 1.8 V TCXO. These are configured by [`src/lora_bench.cpp`](../src/lora_bench.cpp); no external LoRa signal wiring is needed. GPIO46 belongs to a different FEM arrangement and is not used by this V4.3 bench.

radio_excludes_audio.text: This bench transfers one existing, unchanged three-second PCM recording between two physical SX1262 radios. It checks the reconstructed bytes on the receiving board against the source. Microphone capture, speaker playback, PTT and live voice streaming are outside this test. The amplifier stays muted through GPIO48 LOW; the radio firmware does not start I2S. Current firmware `lora-integrity-3-timing` retains the onboard OLED progress display and advertises `timing_schema: 1` for measured chunking/dechunking intervals.

fabrication_hold.text: Do not release manufacturing files as production-ready while module geometry, pad order, acoustic-port geometry or antenna clearance remains provisional. Continue the schematic and dimensioned placement work with clearly marked placeholders, and list the exact measurements needed to finish. A schematic/DRC pass cannot validate a guessed footprint.
